cluster_reason: CountingPathVisitor has a direct implementation/usage relationship with SimplePathVisitor (internal dependency present). Both are concrete path visitor implementations and form a cohesive visitor subdomain; they have limited direct external dependents compared with core utilities like PathUtils or Counters, so moving them together into a visitor subpackage groups related behavior while minimizing widespread API surface changes.

blocks.goal: Move the selected cluster of path visitor classes to a new subpackage.

ops.details: Create the destination subpackage org.apache.commons.io.file.visitor if it does not exist.
Move CountingPathVisitor to the visitor subpackage to group visitor implementations.
Move SimplePathVisitor to the visitor subpackage alongside CountingPathVisitor.
